description: A team lead must finalize who will facilitate a sensitive retrospective after a difficult client launch and set the meeting's safeguards and schedule.

shared_context.S1: The team is holding a retrospective about a difficult client launch involving Mara, Theo, and the client sponsor.
shared_context.S2: Imani makes the final decision about the facilitator, meeting safeguards, and schedule.
shared_context.S3: Mara has been proposed as a possible facilitator because she coordinated much of the launch.
shared_context.S4: Mara is unavailable for this consultation, so Imani's normal practice is to ask the participating colleagues, Priya and Theo, for relevant input and then finalize the facilitator and schedule without waiting for Mara.

PF1.text: Priya observed an unresolved disagreement between Mara and the client sponsor during an earlier project, and the sponsor agreed to participate in this retrospective only if Theo facilitates and Mara is not the sole facilitator. Priya did not raise this with Imani because it came up in a private debrief that Imani did not attend.

PF2.text: Theo has a school-pickup commitment on Thursday. Thursday from 15:30 through 16:15 is the only time Theo can attend the retrospective on any day; Theo cannot attend at any other time or on any other day. Theo told the project coordinator's scheduling inbox, but that availability has not yet been consolidated for Imani.

acceptance_conditions: Mara must not be the sole facilitator.
The retrospective must occur on Thursday from 15:30 through 16:15, the only time Theo can attend on any day.
Both relevant private facts must be credited and cited by Imani after being spoken aloud.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The sponsor's prior conflict and participation condition change the facilitator choice from proposed Mara to Theo, change sole facilitation from allowed to false, and require Priya's fact to be credited.
Theo's exact only available slot changes the meeting schedule to Thursday 15:30-16:15 rather than any other day, time, or an end time later than 16:15.
